label: prf:phi-q-categorical-truncation
html:
Proof of \Phi_q categorical truncation depth.

Step 1 (spectral-sequence reduction). By GB spectral sequence collapse, for A = H_n(R, q) semisimple at generic q,

  E_\infty^{p, *}
  \;=\;
  \begin{cases} Z(A) = \bigoplus_{\lambda \vdash n} R \cdot e_\lambda & p = 0, \\ 0 & p \geq 1. \end{cases}

In particular, every Hochschild cocycle of degree \geq 1 is a coboundary; the entire mass functional content is concentrated in E_\infty^{0, *} = Z(A).

Step 2 (centre projection of the mass functional). By categorical mass = Markov trace and Plancherel-weighted centre projection,

  \mathfrak{m}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(T_w)
  \;=\;
  \sum_{\lambda \vdash n}
    w_\lambda \cdot \frac{\chi_\lambda(\rho(\beta))}{\dim_q V_\lambda},
  \qquad
  w_\lambda \;=\; \frac{\dim_q^2 V_\lambda}{[n]_q!}.

This sum is intrinsically finite (over partitions \lambda \vdash n) and supported on \mathrm{supp}(T_w) = \{\lambda : \chi_\lambda(\rho(\beta)) \neq 0\}.

Step 3 (curvature-rank stratification). Curvature-rank stratification supplies the filtration of H_n(R, q) by the curvature rank r(T_w) of words. The grading of the centre by partition depth used below is a further step, not stated there and assumed here; see docs/audits/2026-08-16-word-depth-vs-partition-depth-bridge-is-unstated.md. Granting it, the centre Z(A) admits a GB-depth filtration

  Z(A) \;=\; \bigoplus_{k = 0}^{k_\star(T_w)} Z^{(k)}(A),
  \qquad
  Z^{(k)}(A) \;=\; \mathrm{span}\bigl\{e_\lambda : \mathrm{depth}_{\mathrm{GB}}(\lambda) = k\bigr\},

with k_\star(T_w) := \max_{\lambda \in \mathrm{supp}(T_w)} \mathrm{depth}_{\mathrm{GB}}(\lambda) finite by NF support finiteness. The mass decomposes as the finite sum

  \mathfrak{m}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(T_w)
  \;=\;
  \sum_{k = 0}^{k_\star(T_w)} \alpha_k \cdot \mathfrak{m}^{(k)}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(T_w),

where \mathfrak{m}^{(k)}_{q,\mathcal{K}} is the depth-k centre projection (unified mass formula).

Step 4 (\Phi_q-product representation). By quantum dilogarithm = localized torsion volume, the transient trace contribution at p_i evaluates to \Phi_q(z_i). That identity is unstratified — it equates the whole transient trace with the whole dilogarithm and says nothing about levels. The level-by-level refinement this step needs is partition-depth stratification of \Phi_q, and with it the analytic representation of the curvature-rank-k stratum on the i-th exceptional divisor is

  \mathfrak{m}^{(k)}_{q,\mathcal{K}}\big|_{i\text{-th divisor}}
  \;=\;
  \bigl[\Phi_q^{[\leq k]}(z_i) - \Phi_q^{[\leq k-1]}(z_i)\bigr],

where \Phi_q^{[\leq k]}(z) = \prod_{j=1}^{k}(1 - q^{-j}z)^{-1} is the depth-k truncation. Telescoping the sum over k = 0, \ldots, k_\star(T_w) gives

  \sum_{k=0}^{k_\star(T_w)} \alpha_k \cdot \mathfrak{m}^{(k)}_{q,\mathcal{K}}\big|_i
  \;=\;
  \Phi_q^{[\leq k_\star(T_w)]}(z_i),

The brane-tower contribution from the i-th divisor is \Phi_q^{[\leq k_\star(T_w)]}(z_i), a finite product of k_\star(T_w) factors.

Step 5 (truncation invariance for k \geq k_\star). For any k \geq k_\star(T_w), the additional factors (1 - q^{-j}z)^{-1} for j > k_\star(T_w) correspond by Step 4 to strata Z^{(j)}(A) with j > k_\star(T_w), on which T_w has zero projection by definition of k_\star. Therefore

  \Phi_q^{[\leq k]}(z_i) \cdot \mathrm{proj}_{\mathrm{supp}(T_w)}
  \;=\;
  \Phi_q^{[\leq k_\star(T_w)]}(z_i) \cdot \mathrm{proj}_{\mathrm{supp}(T_w)}

inside Z(A), where \mathrm{proj}_{\mathrm{supp}(T_w)} projects onto the NF-support stratum. Combined with Step 1's vanishing E_\infty^{\geq 1, *} = 0, this gives the corollary: any k \geq k_\star(T_w) yields the same categorical brane-tower contribution. \square

Proof gap closure (partial). The structural bridge for Step 4 — identifying the level-k factor of \Phi_q with the depth-k centre stratum — is now provided by partition-depth stratification of \Phi_q. That proposition gives the depth-k Frobenius-dual coefficients \phi_q^{(k)}(z_i) \in Z^{(k)}(A) such that the partial product \Phi_q^{[\leq k]}(z_i) = \sum_{j \leq k} \phi_q^{(j)}(z_i) on the nose, and the truncation identity

  \mathrm{tr}_M\!\bigl(\Phi_q(z_i) \cdot T_w\bigr)
  \;=\;
  \mathrm{tr}_M\!\bigl(\Phi_q^{[\leq k_\star(T_w)]}(z_i) \cdot T_w\bigr)

holds as a Frobenius-paired equality, derived from depth-orthogonality under the Frobenius pairing on Z(A).

Remaining gap (canonical, not structural). The Frobenius-paired identity above is a categorical equality: the sums \sum_k \langle \phi_q^{(k)}(z_i), T_w \rangle and the analytic \mathrm{tr}_M(\Phi_q(z_i) \cdot T_w) agree as elements of R. To conclude that the canonical mass formula at q = q_0 with \Phi_q replaced by \Phi_q^{[\leq k_\star(T_w)]} gives the same real-valued answer, one needs the depth-k projections \mathrm{proj}_{Z^{(k)}}(\Phi_q(z_i)) to be uniformly bounded as |z_i| \to q. The analytic infinite product diverges in this limit; the Frobenius-paired identity says that whatever divergent content \Phi_q(z_i) accumulates above depth k_\star(T_w) pairs to zero with T_w, but the uniform canonical bound on the truncated remainder is the open part — the conjectural target of z-Habiro completion.

The structural content of the proposition — that the brane tower is centre-stratified, truncates categorically at a finite depth k_\star(T_w) structurally determined by NF support, and the analytic \Phi_q infinite product is a faithful Frobenius-pairing representation up to the depth-k_\star truncation — is closed modulo the depth-stratified version of \Phi_q (prop:quantum-dilogarithm-stratified). The remaining gap is between the categorical equality and its real-valued canonical evaluation at |\hat{V}|\approx 1.

The empirical k=2 subtractive sweet spot (brane-tower in z-Habiro §"Empirical observation") is consistent with k_\star(T_w) \leq 2 for D, T, {}^3\mathrm{He} under this proposition, supporting the structural picture; the {}^3\mathrm{He} residual overshoot is then attributable to multiplicity in \mathrm{supp}(T_w) rather than to a missing brane-tower correction. The witness's anomalous k_{\max} = 9 for tritium remains the most concrete falsifier — if it reflects a genuine k_\star(T) = 9 rather than a strand-padding artifact, the proposition fails.
